brief:
Nabih Berri, speaker of the Lebanese parliament, stated that any effort to repeal Lebanon's law boycotting Israel will not pass through parliament, according to Maan Wire. Berri's remarks came amid ongoing debates over the country's position on the boycott legislation.

The boycott law remains a contentious issue in Lebanese politics, with the parliamentary speaker signaling strong resistance to its removal from the legal framework.
title: Lebanese speaker says parliament will reject Israel boycott law repeal
